evals.name: node-app-obvious-issues
evals.prompt: Run a doc audit on this project
evals.expected_output: Should find: 5 broken links (api-reference.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, auth.md, schema.md, websocket.md), 1 stale version (architecture.md says Node 16.x but package.json requires >=18), misplaced setup instructions in README duplicating docs/setup.md, and duplicated installation steps + prerequisites between README and docs/setup.md.

assertions.description: Notes install duplication between README and setup.md

evals.name: python-lib-subtle-issues
evals.prompt: Run a doc audit on this project
evals.expected_output: Should find: 3 broken links (api-reference.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, CHANGELOG.md), Pydantic version conflict (v1 vs v2), Python version conflict (3.10+ vs >=3.11), tech stack duplicated in 3 files, installation duplicated in README and getting-started.md.

assertions.description: Flags Pydantic v1 vs v2 contradiction
Notes install duplication between README and getting-started.md

evals.name: clean-project-false-positives
evals.prompt: Run a doc audit on this project
evals.expected_output: Should find 1 real issue: the toMatchBaseline API usage contradiction (Jest matcher in README vs regular method in api.md). Otherwise clean — all links valid, no stale content, no duplication, good structure. Total issues <= 5.

assertions.description: Does not report valid links as broken
Does not invent stale content claims
Catches toMatchBaseline usage contradiction (Jest matcher vs regular method)
